description: § 86 provisional income uses AGI after the NOL deduction (Schedule 1 line 8a). Single 2025: pension $40,000, benefits $30,000, NOL $20,000. Without the NOL: provisional 55,000 → taxable benefits $22,350, taxable income without the NOL 40,000 + 22,350 − 15,750 = $46,600 → deduction min(20,000, 80% × 46,600) = $20,000. With it: MAGI 20,000, provisional 35,000 → 85% × 1,000 + 4,500 = $5,350 taxable; AGI 25,350; taxable income $9,600.
